`final class FileAsset`<br/>
**Extends:** [`Asset`](/reference/resources/asset/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.asset.impl` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [FileAsset.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/asset/impl/FileAsset.java)

An asset read from a file on disk.

## Description

A `File`, or a `String` path that is not in the classpath but exists on disk, gives one; its id is the absolute path.
